chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ad-Daynawari narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Kufi narrated to us, saying: Umayra bint Usayma narrated to me, saying: My grandfather al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Dhamra, from Ka'b al-Ahbar, that he said:

On the Day of Resurrection, the people will be gathered in four categories: a category of riders, a category walking on their feet, a category groveling, and a category on their faces, deaf, dumb, and blind, who do not understand, are not spoken to, and are not permitted to apologize. Those are the ones whose faces the Fire will scorch, and they therein will be in severe affliction.

It was said to him: 'O Ka'b, who are these people who will be gathered on their faces, and this is their condition?' Ka'b said: 'Those are the ones who were upon deviation, apostasy, and breaking the covenant. Evil is what their souls sent before for them when they meet Allah with the sin of fighting their caliph, the guardian of their prophet, their scholar, their master, their superior, the bearer of the banner, the guardian of the Pond, the hoped-for and the hope of this world. He is the standard that is not ignored, and the straight path from which whoever deviates perishes and falls into the Fire. That is Ali, by the Lord of Ka'b, the most knowledgeable of them, the earliest in peace (Islam), and the most prudent of all. Ka'b marveled at those who preferred others to Ali.'

And from the lineage of Ali is al-Qa'im al-Mahdi, who will change the earth into another earth, and by him Jesus son of Mary will argue against the Christians of Rome and China. Indeed, al-Qa'im al-Mahdi from the lineage of Ali is the most similar of people to Jesus son of Mary in creation, character, demeanor, and dignity. Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will give him what He gave the prophets and will increase him and favor him. Indeed, the Qa'im from the offspring of Ali has a disappearance like the disappearance of Joseph, and a return like the return of Jesus son of Mary. Then he will appear after his disappearance with the rising of the red star, the destruction of al-Zawra' (which is Ar-Riy), the sinking of al-Muzawarra' (which is Baghdad), the emergence of al-Sufyani, and the war of the offspring of Abbas with the youths of Armenia and Azerbaijan. That is a war in which thousands and thousands will be killed, each seizing an adorned sword, over which black banners will flutter. That is a war mixed with red death and the grey plague.

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ الْمَهْدِيُّ: The Risen One, the Guided One (Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What are the four categories of people on the Day of Resurrection and who is al-Qa'im al-Mahdi according to Ka'b al-Ahbar?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* links the eschatological fate of the deviant to their rejection of Ali ibn Abi Talib, whom Ka'b al-Ahbar identifies as the 'Standard' and 'Holder of the Basin.' It further contextualizes the Mahdi’s occultation by comparing it to Joseph’s, while detailing specific apocalyptic signs such as the Sufyani’s emergence and the destruction of Baghdad, reinforcing the Shia doctrine of the Imam's hidden presence and eventual return.
